scope: Part B of instruction 33-24, run on the WAPR pose pool of 33-22 E4 (750 frames, CNOS+NOCTIS masks). The FoundationPose per-call scores of the 33-19 E1 pool and XYZ-IBD are not in this file and remain with the server.
rows: one row per mask with status 'ok': image=(dataset, scene_id, im_id), object=obj_id, score, correct (field 'correct' of S22_E4)
sampling: k frames drawn uniformly without replacement from all 150 frames of the dataset (not only frames with pairs)
seed: random.Random(f'{dataset}|{score}|{k}') drives frame sampling; the tool seed is the draw index 0..999

outcomes.correct: reversed for expected_reversed, comparable for expected_comparable
outcomes.wrong: comparable for expected_reversed, reversed for expected_comparable

readings.RB1: fp_single, k=10: correct >= 90% on every classic dataset -> 'ten frames suffice to detect the reversal'; otherwise list the datasets below
readings.RB2: every (dataset, score), k=10: wrong <= 1% -> 'no wrong direction at ten frames'; otherwise list
readings.RB3: smallest k with correct >= 90% per (dataset, score); '>20' if none
readings.classic_average: unweighted mean of the five datasets' shares
